scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run check:dropdown && npm test

scripts.docs:format: prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --check docs/src docs/astro.config.mjs docs/tsconfig*.json docs/tests docs/browser
